answer_1.quote: One of these tasks is image captioning, whose objective is to generate a caption that describes the given image.

answer_2.quote: The performance in image captioning has been primarily measured in automatic metrics (e.g., CIDEr) on popular benchmarks, such as MSCOCO and Flickr8k.

answer_4.quote: The first four authors of this paper conducted all evaluations; none of them are color blind or low vision, two are native English speakers, and one is a graduate student in linguistics.
answer_4.guideline: We base our manual evaluations on two main scores: precision and recall. We also consider three types of penalty: fluency, conciseness, and inclusive language.
